name: one_pole_a0p01
description: one-pole IIR y' = y + alpha*(x - y), alpha = 0.01, vs single_pole_iir_filter_ff

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: GNU Radio computes the filter in double, the float instance in float32: rounding differences only (measured <= 0.001 LSB).

fixed_vs_float.rationale: The update alpha*(x - y) stops once it truncates to 0: dead band 100.0 Q15 LSB in Q15, plus output quantization; alpha is quantized to Q15 (relative error 9.8e-04), which shifts the transients slightly. Minimum SNR is the measured value - 1 dB.

The update alpha*(x - y) stops once it rounds to 0: dead band 50.0 Q15 LSB in Q15, plus output quantization; alpha is quantized to Q15 (relative error 9.8e-04), which shifts the transients slightly. Minimum SNR is the measured value - 1 dB.

The update alpha*(x - y) stops once it rounds to 0: dead band 12.5 Q15 LSB in Q17, plus output quantization; alpha is quantized to Q17 (relative error 2.1e-04), which shifts the transients slightly. Minimum SNR is the measured value - 1 dB.
